speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome. I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To understand the severity and cause, I need to start by asking: How long have you been experiencing these breathing difficulties, and what specific symptoms, such as cyanosis or grunting, are you noticing?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN).

The history of late preterm birth (32 weeks), C-section delivery without labor, and maternal gestational diabetes strongly supports this diagnosis due to delayed clearance of fetal lung fluid. I recommend requesting a Chest_X-Ray to confirm hyperinflation and fluid in the fissures.
